text:
I chose a two-stage Miller op-amp with an NMOS input pair. It has the best output swing, gives about 70–80 dB of gain with L ≈ 1 µm, and fits the power budget easily. None of the numbers below have been simulated. They are hand estimates from the device table, and the optimiser is expected to tune them.

**Topology**
- **Bias:** a diode-connected nfet (MB) sinks the 10 µA IREF. Its gate voltage sets the tail sink M5 (×4, 40 µA) and the output sink M6 (×25, 250 µA).
- **Stage 1:** NMOS pair M1/M2 with a PMOS mirror load M3/M4.
  - M1 is driven by vinn and drains into the diode side of the mirror.
  - M2 is driven by vinp and drives the high-impedance node out1.
  - When vinp rises, out1 falls, the PMOS M7 conducts more, and vout rises. So vinp is the non-inverting input, as required.
- **Stage 2:** PMOS common-source stage M7 with nfet sink M6.
  - M7 uses the same L as M3/M4, which keeps the systematic offset low.
- **Compensation:** Miller capacitor Cc in series with nulling resistor Rz (Rz ≳ 1/gm7), connected from out1 to vout.

**Initial sizing, hand estimates (not simulated)**

| Quantity | Estimate | Requirement |
|---|---|---|
| gm1 | ≈ 300 µS (20 µA per side, gm/Id ≈ 15) | – |
| GBW = gm1/(2π·Cc), Cc = 3 pF | ≈ 16 MHz | ≥ 10 MHz |
| gm7 | ≈ 2.5 mS | > 2.2·gm1·CL/Cc ≈ 2.2 mS for 60° PM |
| SR = min(40 µA/3 pF, 250 µA/13 pF) | ≈ 13 V/µs and 19 V/µs | ≥ 10 V/µs |
| Total current | ≈ 10 + 40 + 250 µA ≈ 300 µA | – |
| Power | ≈ 0.54 mW | ≤ 1 mW |
| Output swing | M7/M6 need only one Vdsat each; 0.3–1.5 V looks feasible | ≥ 1.2 V |

```spice
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* bias: sink reference current
MB  ibias ibias vss vss nfet W={WB} L={LN}
* tail current source
M5  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W={W5} L={LN}
* NMOS input pair (vinp -> out1 side => non-inverting overall)
M1  n1    vinn  tail vss nfet W={W1} L={L1}
M2  out1  vinp  tail vss nfet W={W1} L={L1}
* PMOS mirror load
M3  n1    n1    vdd vdd pfet W={W3} L={L3}
M4  out1  n1    vdd vdd pfet W={W3} L={L3}
* second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink
M7  vout  out1  vdd vdd pfet W={W7} L={L3}
M6  vout  ibias vss vss nfet W={W6} L={LN}
* Miller compensation with nulling resistor
Rz  out1  nz  {RZ}
Cc  nz    vout {CC}
.ends dut
```
